nodes.description: Mapping of address to UserInfo tracking token0/token1 rewards and reward debts in SorbettoFragola.
Immutable-ish IUniswapV3Pool reference used for all liquidity, swap and position operations.
Address with governance privileges, gates onlyGovernance functions.
Address pending acceptance of the governance role.
Sorbetto strategy contract address supplying protocolFee, twap and tick parameters.
Accumulated protocol fees in token0, decremented in collectProtocolFees.
Accumulator of token0 fees per LP share used for reward debt accounting.
Current lower tick of the contract's Uniswap V3 position.
Current upper tick of the contract's Uniswap V3 position.
External payable nonReentrant deposit that mints pool liquidity and contract shares to msg.sender.
External nonReentrant withdrawal burning liquidity proportionally to shares and returning tokens.
Governance-only nonReentrant function that burns, swaps imbalanced token and re-mints liquidity.
External nonReentrant function that repositions all contract liquidity within new ticks.
External nonReentrant function letting a user withdraw their accrued fee rewards.
Governance-only external nonReentrant function withdrawing accrued protocol fees.
Pool mint callback pulling token0/token1 from the decoded payer.
Pool swap callback paying the owed token amount for the swap.
Internal payment helper performing WETH wrapping, safeTransfer or safeTransferFrom.
External function transferring governance to pendingGovernance when called by it.
Internal function updating global fee accumulators and the account's reward debt.
Internal function poking the pool, collecting fees and splitting protocol/user shares.
Caller-controlled address consumed as payer, account and governance checks.
Block time used for permit deadlines and TWAP-based deviation checks.
Low-level token.call inside pay/TransferHelper that transfers value to an arbitrary token.
IWETH9.deposit{value}() payable external call wrapping ETH inside pay.
safeTransferETH sending the whole contract ETH balance back to msg.sender.
Deposit parameter for desired token0 amount.
Deposit parameter for desired token1 amount.
Withdraw parameter giving the LP shares to burn.
collectFees parameter for the token0 fee amount requested.
collectFees parameter for the token1 fee amount requested.
updateVault modifier parameter naming the user whose rewards are refreshed.
Local liquidity amount computed in deposit and passed to pool.mint.
Local previous position liquidity used to compute new share amounts.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the payer in the mint callback data and as the share recipient in deposit.
acceptGovernance requires msg.sender to equal pendingGovernance before granting governance.
checkDeviation relies on a TWAP derived from block timestamps to gate deposit.
checkDeviation on withdraw depends on block.timestamp-based TWAP observation.
amount0Desired flows into liquidityForAmounts and the deposit share computation.
amount1Desired flows into liquidityForAmounts and the deposit share computation.
shares parameter is consumed by pool.burnLiquidityShare and _burn in withdraw.
amount0 requested is compared against and subtracted from user.token0Rewards.
amount1 requested is compared against and subtracted from user.token1Rewards.
account parameter is forwarded to _updateFeesReward to refresh a user's reward debt.
collectFees reads and writes the userInfo storage entry for msg.sender.
_updateFeesReward writes userInfo token0Rewards/token1Rewards and paid accumulators.
token0PerShareStored is read and updated by _updateFeesReward.
accruedProtocolFees0 is decremented with sub after the balance checks in collectProtocolFees.
onlyGovernance requires msg.sender == governance before rebalance executes.
acceptGovernance overwrites the governance state variable with msg.sender.
pendingGovernance is the required caller and is cleared inside acceptGovernance.
strategy settings are queried through the checkDeviation modifier and updateVault on deposit.
pool.mint called in deposit invokes uniswapV3MintCallback back into this contract.
pool.swap triggers uniswapV3SwapCallback re-entering the contract during rebalance.
rerange burns and re-mints liquidity through the pool and updates ticks.
rebalance reads slot0, swaps and mints through the pool instance.
_updateFeesReward queries pool.positionLiquidity before poking fees.
uniswapV3MintCallback calls pay which performs external token transfers.
uniswapV3SwapCallback calls pay which performs external token transfers.
pay performs low-level token.call transfers controlled by the token address.
pay calls IWETH9.deposit with value to wrap ETH before transferring.
refundETH sends the full ETH balance to msg.sender after minting shares in deposit.
_earnFees returns collected user fees consumed by _updateFeesReward accumulators.
updateVault modifier runs _updateFeesReward before collectFees body executes.
updateVault modifier runs _updateFeesReward before deposit logic executes.
updateVault modifier runs _updateFeesReward before withdraw logic executes.
_updateFeesReward is invoked via updateVault(address(0)) on rerange.
liquidity local is passed to pool.mint and _calcShare inside deposit.
liquidityLast local is used as the divisor in the share calculation in deposit.
collectProtocolFees calls pay, which forwards value to msg.sender through external calls.
collectFees calls pay after reducing state, enabling external token callbacks.

normalization_plan.reason: amount0Desired is a deposit parameter directly bound to the deposit function's liquidity computation.
amount1Desired is a deposit parameter directly bound to the deposit function's liquidity computation.
shares is the withdraw parameter directly consumed by the withdraw function's burn logic.
amount0 is a collectFees parameter directly checked against and subtracted from user rewards.
amount1 is a collectFees parameter directly checked against and subtracted from user rewards.
account is the updateVault parameter directly forwarded to the _updateFeesReward core function.
liquidity is a deposit local variable passed straight into pool.mint and _calcShare.
liquidityLast is a deposit local variable used only in the deposit share calculation.
